title: Philadelphia Experiment sailors stuck in walls

tellings.quote: And that's temporal displacement. The rumors that the people were some people were stuck between a wall or like physical physical matter and space.

plain: There is an old story about a secret test in Philadelphia in 1943, known as the Philadelphia Experiment, in which something strange is said to have happened to a ship and its crew. Dave Rossi, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on the rumour that some of the sailors ended up stuck inside walls or other solid matter. He calls this "temporal displacement", meaning people being shifted out of their normal place in time and space, which would point to physics far beyond anything known if it were true.
